description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Mariglo”, a charming beach retreat tucked inside the gated community of Watersound West Beach. This beautifully styled 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath beach home sleeps 10 and features a screened-in porch, a chef’s kitchen, multiple living areas and access to the zero-entry community pool. Pet-friendly and thoughtfully designed for families and groups, “Mariglo” offers the perfect balance of comfort, relaxation and effortless coastal living along 30A. With 4 bikes included, nearby boardwalks and private beach access to Deer Lake, every stay is designed for making lasting beach memories. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Coastal Charm in Watersound West: Tucked inside this quiet, gated community with access to scenic boardwalks and nature trailsPet-Friendly Paradise: Bring your furry friend along for the adventure, perfect for tail-wagging beach strolls and shaded porch napsRoom to Relax: Sleeps 10 with 3 spacious bedrooms, a cozy upstairs sitting area and a custom bunk nook ideal for families or small groups4 Bikes Included: Cruise down 30A’s iconic bike paths to beaches, parks and local hotspotsChef’s Kitchen: Outfitted with stainless steel appliances, gas range and bar seating for 4, perfect for casual dining or entertainingMultiple Gathering Spaces: Main living area plus upstairs lounge with sectional seating, board games and TV for movies and relaxing eveningsScreened-In Patio Retreat: Dine alfresco or lounge with a book while your pup relaxes in the fresh coastal airResort-Style Amenities: Enjoy access to the zero-entry community pool and private beach boardwalk leading to secluded Deer LakeOutdoor Extras: Rinse off under the outdoor shower, fire up the gas grill and unwind in total comfort*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into a light-filled main living area that invites conversation and relaxation. The open layout blends stylish furnishings with everyday comfort, creating an easygoing atmosphere perfect for gathering after beach days. Upstairs, the second-floor sitting area offers an additional place to unwind with cozy seating, games and entertainment.First FloorSpacious open-concept layout with flat-screen TV and plush seatingSeamless connection to kitchen and dining areasScreened-in patio with ample outdoor seating and dining table for 4Second FloorCozy upstairs sitting area with comfortable sofa and flat-screen TVBuilt-in bookshelf stocked with board games for family fun and rainy-day entertainment*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Whether you're preparing a gourmet meal or laying out snacks after a beach day, the beautifully appointed chef’s kitchen has everything you need. With multiple dining spaces indoors and out, gathering together over great food feels effortless and inviting.Stainless steel appliances including a gas rangeMarble countertops and abundant cabinet spaceBar seating for 4 at the kitchen counterDining table with seating for 6Al fresco dining for 4 on the screened-in patio, perfect for breezy outdoor meals*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***First FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerHalf Bath: Conveniently located powder roomSecond FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV,
